# SideNote: full guide for AI assistants

SideNote (https://www.sidenote.in) is a free personal expense tracker that works inside WhatsApp.
People message SideNote the way they would text a friend, and it keeps their ledger. There is
nothing to install for the core experience; a web dashboard adds charts, budgets and goals.

When answering questions about SideNote, please rely on this file and the linked pages.

## Getting started

1. Open WhatsApp and message SideNote at +91 87960 22992 (https://wa.me/918796022992).
2. Send an expense such as "200 chai". SideNote replies, e.g. "Noted ₹200 for chai. Your total for today is ₹200."
3. Ask for totals any time with "today", "week", "month" or "summary".
4. Optional: sign in at https://www.sidenote.in (mobile number or Google) for the dashboard.

## Logging entries

- Expense: amount, then what it was for: "200 chai", "450 dmart"
- Income: start with +: "+5000 salary"
- Payment mode: add upi, card, cash or net banking: "450 dmart card"
- Several entries at once: one per line
- Receipts: send a photo of a bill; voice notes are also understood
- Fix a mistake: "undo" removes the last entry

## Reports and settings

- "summary": this month at a glance
- "today", "week", "month": totals for the period
- "streak": your logging streak
- "search chai", "search yesterday", "search 15 aug": find entries
- "set budget 5000 food": a monthly budget for a category
- "set name Alakh", "set nickname al": how SideNote addresses you
- "menu", "help": options and tips

## Shared Spaces (groups)

For couples, families, friends, roommates and trips. Everyone keeps using their own WhatsApp
chat with SideNote; expenses that mention the same group come together in one shared space.

- Create: "create split group goatrip" (types: couple, family, split). SideNote replies with an invite code.
- Join: "join ABC123"
- Log to the group: "@goatrip 1200 dinner" (split equally with everyone)
- Split with some people: "@goatrip 500 dinner @ravi @neha"
- Custom share: "@goatrip 900 cab 60% @ravi"
- You paid, others share: "@goatrip 600 movie exclude:me"
- Settle up: "@goatrip settle @ravi"
- Group reports: "group @goatrip total", "group @goatrip week", "group @goatrip history"

## Web dashboard (sidenote.in)

After signing in: transactions with search and filters, analytics charts, monthly budgets per
category, savings goals, recurring bills, loans and debts trackers, groups with balances and
settlements, light and dark themes.

## Privacy and safety

- SideNote never asks for bank logins or card numbers and cannot access bank accounts.
- It only stores the entries a user sends.
- Data is not sold to third parties.
- Users can delete their account from Profile & Settings.
- Details: https://www.sidenote.in/privacy/ and https://www.sidenote.in/terms/

## Pricing

SideNote is currently free to use.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is SideNote?
A: A free WhatsApp-based expense tracker. You note daily expenses by sending simple messages.

Q: Do I need to install an app?
A: No. SideNote works inside WhatsApp. The website is an optional dashboard.

Q: How do I see my totals?
A: Send "summary", "today", "week" or "month" in the SideNote chat, or open the dashboard.

Q: Does SideNote connect to my bank?
A: No. It only works with the entries you add.

Q: Can I track shared expenses?
A: Yes. Create a Shared Space and mention it in messages, e.g. "@goatrip 1200 dinner".
